subject: Onboarding can run online: one Cloudflare Worker with D1 inside onboarding/
body: D-onboarding-017: onboarding/wrangler.jsonc serves the built harness plus /api (invite-code email accounts, strategy revisions, rep log, short-lived GPT live keys) from D1. Everything is inside onboarding/; nothing at the root changed. Deploy waits for Cam's Cloudflare access. If the app lane later wants the same API, the Worker can move to a shared place.
